title: CI failure record
description: One JSON object per CI failure, written to reports/failures/. A minor schema version only adds optional fields. Unknown fields fail validation. Version 1.1 (#11) adds rule, preferenceMode, tuple, uiSlot, accessibleName, exceptionId, and tokenRole, #6 adds metric, and it takes inputMode as mouse, keyboard, or touch. A 1.0 record carries none of the 1.1 fields.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version the record was written against.

gate.description: The check that failed: the <job> in `pnpm ci:<job>`.

inputMode.description: Input mode, such as pointer, touch, or keyboard. From 1.1, mouse, keyboard, or touch.

displayMode.description: Display mode, such as light, dark, or forced-colors.

semanticRole.description: Semantic role under test: the failing element's ARIA role.

artifacts.description: Paths inside the uploaded reports artifact.

reproCommand.description: Local command that reproduces the failure. It starts with pnpm, optionally after VAR=value pairs, and needs no secrets: no $ expansion, no secrets. reference, and no variable named like a token, secret, or password.

rule.description: 1.1: the rule that failed, such as axe's color-contrast.

preferenceMode.description: 1.1: the preference row the cell ran under.

tuple.description: 1.1: the appearance tuple, as designLanguage/colorScheme/typography/displayMode, such as platform-neutral/warm-parchment/humanist-ui/light.

uiSlot.description: 1.1: the #19 primitive slot of the failing element, its data-ui-slot.

exceptionId.description: 1.1: the quality/exceptions.yml or runtime-budgets.json exception that covers the failure.

tokenRole.description: 1.1: the color role the boundary's resolved tokens give the rendered color, or hard-coded when none does.

metric.description: 1.1 (#6): the runtime budget a record breaks, such as js, css, or remote.
